nonShimCmdlets.reason: The raw Graph call the shim itself wraps. It is never wrapped by the shim.
An authentication cmdlet with no Graph route, so there is nothing for the shim to wrap.

nonComparableEntityTypes.reason: The 42 resources on this entity carry up to 82 properties while the CSDL entity carries 16. Their real surface is the settings catalog, which phase 7 covers.
The entity carries displayName, id, templateId and values. Its 3 resources project the names inside the values bag as properties, so every one of them reads as orphaned.
